excubitorium.definition:
n. A gallery in a church, where persons watched all
   night.
excubitorium.translation: n. 值夜人的职位或岗位, 值夜人的房间

excudit.translation: <拉>(本品)由他(或她)印(或刻)[字面意义： he(or she)printed(or engraved)(this)]

exculpable.definition: Capable of being exculpated; deserving exculpation.

exculpate.definition: v pronounce not guilty of criminal charges
exculpate.translation:
vt. 使无罪, 开脱
[法] 使无罪, 申辩无罪, 辩解

exculpated.translation: v. 开脱, 使无罪( exculpate的过去式和过去分词 )

exculpates.definition: v pronounce not guilty of criminal charges
exculpates.translation: v. 开脱, 使无罪( exculpate的第三人称单数 )

exculpating.translation: v. 开脱, 使无罪( exculpate的现在分词 )

exculpation.definition: n. the act of freeing from guilt or blame
exculpation.translation:
n. 使无罪
[法] 免罪, 赦罪, 辩解

exculpatory.definition: a. clearing of guilt or blame
exculpatory.translation:
a. 辩解的, 辩明无罪的
[法] 开脱罪责的, 申明无罪的, 昭雪的

exculpatory evidence.translation: [法] 开脱罪责的证据, 昭雪的证据

exculpatory exception.translation: [经] 根据免责规定的抗辩

excuria.translation: <拉>法庭外[字面意义：out of court]

excurrent.definition:
a. Running or flowing out
a. Running or extending out; as, an excurrent midrib, one
   which projects beyond the apex of a leaf; an excurrent steam or trunk,
   one which continues to the top.
a. Characterized by a current which flows outward; as, an
   excurrent orifice or tube.
excurrent.translation:
a. 流出的, 流出性的, (树形)塔状的, (叶脉)延伸的
[医] 排泄的, 传出的, 离心的

excurse.definition: v. t. To journey or pass thought.
excurse.translation: vi. 跑掉, 远足, 离题, 短程旅行

excurses.definition:
plural of excurse
v. t. To journey or pass thought.
excurses.translation: (excurse 的复数) vi. 跑掉, 远足, 离题, 短程旅行

excursion.definition: n. a journey taken for pleasure
excursion.translation:
n. 远足, 游览圆, 短程旅行
[医] 移动, 离轨, 逸出

excursionist.definition: n a tourist who is visiting sights of interest
excursionist.translation: n. 远足者, 游览者, 短途旅行者

excursionists.definition:
plural of excursionist
n a tourist who is visiting sights of interest
excursionists.translation: (excursionist 的复数) n. 远足者, 游览者, 短途旅行者

excursions.definition:
n. a journey taken for pleasure
n. wandering from the main path of a journey
excursions.translation: n. （尤指集体）远足( excursion的复数形式 ); 短途旅行; （短期的）涉足; 离题

excursive.definition: s (of e.g. speech and writing) tending to depart from the main point or cover a wide range of subjects
excursive.translation:
a. 游览的, 离题的, 散漫的
[医] 移动性的

excursus.definition: n a message that departs from the main subject
excursus.translation: n. 附记, 补说, 附录, 离题话

excursuses.definition: n. a message that departs from the main subject
excursuses.translation: n. 附录, 附记, 补说( excursus的名词复数 )

excurvate.translation: a. 弯曲的, 往外弯曲的

excurved.translation: a. 弯曲的, 往外弯曲的

excusable.definition:
a. capable of being overlooked
s. easily excused or forgiven
excusable.translation:
a. 可原谅的, 可容许的, 可免除的
[法] 可辩解的, 可原谅的, 可免除的

excusably.definition: r in an excusable manner or to an excusable degree
excusably.translation: adv. 可辩解地, 可宽恕地

excusal.translation: n. 原谅, 免除(税款或罚款等的)

excusatory.translation: a. 道歉的, 辩解的

excuse.definition:
n. a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.
n. a note explaining an absence
v. accept an excuse for
v. grant exemption or release to
excuse.translation:
vt. 原谅, 申辩, 做为...的托辞
n. 致歉, 理由, 饶恕, 借口

excuse oneself.translation: 为自己辩解, 请求准许离开

excuse oneself from.translation: 请求免除, 得到解脱

excuse oneself from....translation: 借口推托, 婉言拒绝

excused.translation: v. 原谅( excuse的过去式和过去分词 ); 使免除; 准许…离开; 为…辩解

excuseless.definition: a. Having no excuse; not admitting of excuse or apology.

excuser.definition:
n. One who offers excuses or pleads in extenuation of the
   fault of another.
n. One who excuses or forgives another.

excuses.definition:
n a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.
n a note explaining an absence
n a poor example
v accept an excuse for
v grant exemption or release to
v serve as a reason or cause or justification of
v defend, explain, clear away, or make excuses for by reasoning
v ask for permission to be released from an engagement
v excuse, overlook, or make allowances for; be lenient with
excuses.translation:
n. 理由( excuse的名词复数 ); 歉意; 拙劣样品
v. 原谅( excuse的第三人称单数 ); 使免除; 准许…离开; 为…辩解

excusing.definition:
v accept an excuse for
v grant exemption or release to
v serve as a reason or cause or justification of
v defend, explain, clear away, or make excuses for by reasoning
v ask for permission to be released from an engagement
v excuse, overlook, or make allowances for; be lenient with

excuss.definition:
v. t. To shake off; to discard.
v. t. To inspect; to investigate; to decipher.
v. t. To seize and detain by law, as goods.

excussion.definition: n. The act of excusing; seizure by law.
